{{Quote|What's her name? Hope it's not who I think it is.|The Weequay, on [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]]|<ref name="Lethal Trackdown">{{TCW|Lethal Trackdown}}</ref>}}
This '''unnamed [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]]''' was seen talking to [[Fong Do/Legends|Fong Do]] in [[Moshi Bar/Legends|Moshi Bar]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He worked for [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka's]] [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|pirate gang]]. He was the first to notice that they were being spied on by [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]. He hinted to Do and they both pulled out their weapons at her. But before a fight could break out Ahsoka threw gold [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] into the air as a distraction and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] left the bar.
